Tracks: A — collection interval and revision size (research). B — budget, staffing and attrition (research). Split from A because A rests on sharp month-to-month calendar variation that public release dates give directly. B's covariates move slowly, trend together and must be hand-built, and B's answer does not change A's model.
Track order: A, then B.
